spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Talking much, gabbling, prattling.
E.
वद to speak, Uṇādi aff. ऊक, the root reiterated.

f. (-ता)
Garrulity, loquaciousness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वावटूकत्वं.

m. (-यः)
A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)

mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि)
Who or what bears or carries much.
E.
वह to bear, कि aff.

(उ) r. 4th cl. वावृतु (वावृत्यते)
1 To choose or select.
2 To serve.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Chosen, appointed.
E.
वृत to be, aff. क्त, and the root reiterated.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Choosing, preferring.
E.
वावृत to choose, शानच् aff.
